note: P4231 (Pro 23:31) — do not look at wine when it is red, sparkling, going down smoothly.

dims.v: captivated gaze — the fascinated look that kindles craving for drink
the looking/gazing at wine in its allure — the fascinated eye that must be refused before it kindles craving
(the wine's allure it is drawn to)
the gaze that must be checked before desire takes hold

raah (look/see) — 'do not LOOK at wine when it is red, when it sparkles'; the warning strikes at the eye, where the fall begins. Refuse the fascinated gaze, for desire follows the look (cf 23:33; the eye as the gateway of temptation). Emergent.
